newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DT started as outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DT started as outperform.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it initiated coverage of DT Industries Inc with an outperform intermediate and long term rating, suitable for aggressive investors.
--Its EPS estimates are $2.52 for FY97 and $2.93 for FY98.

--DT makes automated production equipment to manufacture or package industrial and consumer products. "DT is successfully consolidating the factory automation equipment market," noted analyst Quint Nufer in a report.
